maya: Quick design sweep — posting the Eval Run preview & screenreader flow mock. want feedback on CTA placement for bulk-approve, the diff filter parity, and a11y readout order. screenshots: https://redwood.design/s/evl-run-preview (1/3) jordan: Looking now. first impression: bulk-approve CTA feels visually heavy next to the scorecard header. maybe move it to a sticky footer for large lists? :thinking_face: maya: Agree sticky footer idea. concern is keyboard focus — if footer is sticky we need predictable tab order so screen readers hit the CTA after the list, not before. sasha: For filter parity: mobile vs desktop filters aren't showing the same options in the mock. we should avoid hidden advanced filters on mobile — users run quick regressions on phones sometimes. kevin: Small copy nit: "Approve Selected" vs "Bulk Approve" — i'd prefer "Approve Selected" (clearer which items will be affected). maya: Good call on copy. Also thinking about contextual CTA states: disabled when selection empty, but show tooltip on hover explaining why. aria: Screenreader flow notes: when diff comparison updates, we should announce "Diff comparison updated. X tests changed." and move focus to the diff summary region. otherwise NVDA users miss the update. maya: Example announcer snippet i proposed: ```html
Diff comparison updated: 7 changed
``` ui-lint-bot: Accessibility check: role=status with aria-live=polite is recommended for non-critical updates. Missing aria-label on the compact diff list (lines). jordan: On the visual side: compact mode density looks good, but the diff inline highlights need 4.5:1 contrast on the indicator pills. current orange on white fails. kevin: Could we try a dark outline ring instead of filling the pill? preserves color meaning but improves contrast. maya: Good idea. Also thinking about keyboard shortcuts for compact diff navigation: `n`/`p` to go next/prev failing test, and `space` to toggle selection. thoughts? aria: keyboard nav ok, but ensure we update `aria-pressed` on toggles and provide `aria-describedby` linking to a hidden summary that says how many selected. maya: Proposed hidden summary: ```html 3 tests selected out of 12 ``` jordan: UX question: should the selection summary be announced every time selection changes? that might be noisy. suggest only announce on focus change or when bulk action becomes available. maya: i like announce-on-focus. less spammy. sasha: Back to filters — we need filter parity mapping doc for engineers. i'll open a ticket with a matrix: desktop vs mobile vs compact. kevin: One more: approval flow microcopy when approval triggers rollout. current says "This will apply changes." let's change to "Approving these tests will mark them as passed for this eval run — changes do not affect model configs." clearer and less scary for PMs. maya: sweet. i'll update mock copy and push a revised Figma. planning to ship a11y checklist with the PR: focus order, live regions, aria attributes, contrast, keyboard shortcuts. anyone want to add items? aria: add screenreader walkthrough steps for QA (NVDA, VoiceOver short scripts). jordan: add a visual regression test for CTA placement in narrow viewports. sasha: adding the filter matrix ticket now. reference: #ENG-4227. maya: Thanks all — i'll post updated screens by EOD and tag you. if no objections we'll land the copy and announce the keyboard shortcuts in release notes. :thumbsup: kevin: lgtm aria: lgtm from a11y side jordan: lgtm ui-lint-bot: Reminder: run `yarn a11y:check` in the branch prior to merge.
